_about: 斗法小队 (cards.md § 1 · § 5, Hanli 2026-10-16): who stands beside 小满 in a fight. A member is a person with their own deck and 气血 (a share of his), never a card; their cards are theirs (cards.json `owner`) and they play them. `by_hui` is who fights beside him in a 回 of the book (第七回 h11: 阿禾 and 孙二狗 on the errands — 「一年里他们揭的第七块牌」; 第八回 h09 and 第九回 h10: 阿禾 — 「孙二狗没有来」); a scene's fight says its own (`foe.party` on the exit game: 第五回's 邹青松 with 阿禾 behind the wall, 秦雁's spar and the 双龙 alone). 银月 sleeps in the 木牌 through 卷一: she is a member from the 卷 she wakes in (`juan`), never a card in a fight before it.

role.zh: 木天灵根 · 治 · 缚

_by_hui: A 今 interlude's 回 (j07, j09) stands for the 古 回 its chapter plays when the save is between scenes there (rules/hui.mjs huiNow reads the chapter's first): 00-zhuji opens on 今·三 before 古七, 01-ji on 今·四 before 古九.
_roaming: Hanli 2026-10-16: 「小队是人数跟剧情走, 剧情是一个人就一个人」 — every fight, a roaming one too (a haunt's, a pool's, the 秘境's), has whoever stands with him by the 回 (`by_hui`). A beast met roaming grows with the party (rules/cards.mjs beastToParty): its 气血 × (1 + `hp` a member) + `power` a member to its blows, and `cards` more of its own deck a member (so it is not simply outlasted), so a pool stays losable with 孙二狗's guard and 阿禾's heals (tests/fight-band-pools: each pool at its first 回 with that 回's party, and alone). A pool entry's own `roaming` stands over this one — a beast the party finds easier or harder (places/*.json: 蛫 0.45, 人鱼 0.3, 獙獙 0.25, 当康 0.6; 天马, 猲狙 and 鬿雀 0.05), and its `extra` deals that many of its own cards again even alone — a slow hard beast fought to the end, not outlasted (4 on 蛫, 天马, 领胡, 人鱼, 豺, 獙獙, 当康 and 鬿雀 — tests/fight-band-pools caps the alone ran-dry at 20%). A story fight's foe is weighed with its party already (its exit's `foe`) and never grows.
_hp: A member's 气血 is a share of his. 0.4 (2026-10-16): at 0.6 · 0.8 灵草谷 was won 78% and lost 18% — the beast could not get past 孙二狗 to him.
